name_en: Iriko meshi — rice cooked with dried sardine stock and root vegetables
summary_ja: いりこ（煮干し）の頭でとった出汁で、身と人参、大根、里芋などを米と炊き込む。いりこの名産地・伊吹島を抱える西讃地域を中心に、季節を問わずつくられる日常食だという。
summary_en: Rice is cooked with dried-sardine stock made from the fish heads, along with the sardine meat, carrot, daikon, and taro. An everyday dish centered on the Seiban region around Ibukijima, an island famed for producing this dried-sardine stock.
source_title: いりこ飯 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kagawa kakimaze — soy-seasoned mixed rice from Shodoshima
summary_ja: たけのこや干しえび、油揚げなどを醤油で煮含め、炊き立てのごはんに混ぜ込む小豆島の郷土料理。醤油の一大産地である島らしく、集落の寄り合いなど大人数の場でふるまわれてきたという。
summary_en: Bamboo shoot, dried shrimp, fried tofu, and other ingredients are simmered in soy sauce and folded into freshly cooked rice. A specialty of Shodoshima, an island long known for soy sauce production, traditionally served to large gatherings such as village meetings.
source_title: かきまぜ 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mossomeshi — five-item rice pressed into a cylindrical mold
summary_ja: いりこや油揚げ、ごぼうなどを甘辛く煮て炊きたてのごはんに混ぜ、円柱形の型で押し抜く。修行僧の精進料理が起源とされ、三豊市では五穀豊穣を祈る百々手祭りの振る舞い飯として親しまれてきたという。
summary_en: Dried sardine, fried tofu, and burdock simmered sweet and salty are mixed into freshly cooked rice, then pressed into a cylindrical mold. Said to trace back to a monk's ascetic meal, it has long been served in Mitoyo at the Momote archery festival held to pray for a good harvest.
source_title: もっそうめし 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Satsuma — grilled white fish and roasted miso ladled over hot rice
summary_ja: 焼いた白身魚の身をほぐし、焦げ目をつけた味噌と魚の出汁でのばして熱々のごはんにかける郷土料理。九州から四国へ海岸沿いに伝わったとされ、香川では「讃岐さつま」とも呼ばれるという。
summary_en: Flaked grilled white fish is combined with lightly toasted miso and fish stock, then poured over hot rice. Said to have traveled along the coast from Kyushu to Shikoku, it is also known in Kagawa as Sanuki satsuma.
source_title: さつま 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Shima no chagayu — rice porridge simmered in bitter roasted tea
summary_ja: 碁石茶やほうじ茶を煮出した湯で米を煮込む粥。田んぼを持たない塩飽諸島の島々で、貴重な米を少なく食べ延ばすための朝食として、味付けをせずお茶の渋みだけで食べられてきたという。
summary_en: Rice is simmered in water infused with goishicha or roasted tea into a porridge. On the rice-paddy-less islands of the Shiwaku archipelago, it is said to have served as breakfast that stretched scarce rice further, eaten unseasoned save for the tea's bitterness.
source_title: 島の茶粥 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Warigo bento — a Shodoshima lunch box packed with molded rice and simmered vegetables
summary_ja: 専用の木枠で型抜きしたごはんと、こんにゃくやしいたけの煮しめを詰め合わせた小豆島の弁当。江戸時代から続く肥土山農村歌舞伎の演目の合間に、20個ほど持ち寄って分け合って食べるという。
summary_en: A Shodoshima lunch box packs rice pressed in a dedicated wooden mold alongside simmered konjac, shiitake, and other vegetables. Around 20 boxes are said to be brought and shared between acts at the Hifuyama rural kabuki performance, an Edo-period tradition still held today.
source_title: わりご弁当 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
